title: The cash back on your coffee lasts 17 days #shorts
description:
ZERO earns 5 cents of cash back on a $4.75 coffee (1%, an illustration). If he carries a balance at 22.36% APR (Federal Reserve G.19, Aug 2026), that coffee costs about 0.3 cents a day in interest, so the cash back is gone in about 17 days. ESTIMATE: our arithmetic; interest compounds daily, so it is slightly faster.

The whole story: https://www.youtube.com/@zerounderstands
